The PSU FRU and Fan FRU tables live in the ufispace/psu-401-* and fan-402825 contracts. The management jack is declared per element from the Management Port LED table - left lamp green 1G link/activity, right lamp amber 10M/100M link/activity. The HIG gives NO table for the port lamps, so the 48 led-arrow and 24 led-dot placements keep their component off/on default; see gaps."},"mgmt-stack":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"photo-measured centres, COMPRESSED TO FIT THE REUSED PARTS: the render's bezels are mgmt RJ45 6.5-18.5, USB 18.6-26.0, console 26.3-37.8 (31.3 mm total), while the three parts placed here stack to 35.7 mm (common/rj45-eth@1 13.2 + common/usb-a-bezel@1 9.3 + std/rj45@2 13.2; before the RJ45 sweep the same trio - common/rj45-port@4, common/usb-a-bezel@1, common/rj45-bezel@2 - stacked to 39.1). They are placed at y 1.6 / 16.9 / 26.4 - the USB lands on its measured centre, the two jacks are pulled up to 2.7 mm off theirs. The same trade the S9510-28DC made with the same three roles. THE TWO JACKS MIRROR - in a 10x crop the mgmt jack's pins are at the bottom and the console's at the top. Before the sweep this fell out of the two components' own defaults (rj45-port@4 composed std/rj45 rotated internally, pins down/LEDs top; rj45-bezel@2 drew pins up) with neither placement carrying a device-level rotate. The RJ45 sweep's FLIP_ORIGIN rule now carries a rotate: 180 on the mgmt placement (common/rj45-eth@1's own unrotated default is keyway-down, the opposite of rj45-port@4's) to preserve this same pins-down/LEDs-top appearance; the console (std/rj45@2) stays unrotated, still pins-up. A first draft rotated the console 180 and the render pass caught it."},"part-numbers":{"note":"vendor-silent in the intake - neither the datasheet nor HIG R1.8 prints an orderable chassis SKU (the S9510-28DC's SKUs came from the owner, not its documents; the same may exist here). FRU part numbers are real and belong to the FRU contracts: PSU-401-DESR/DISB-1/AESR/AISB and FAN-402825-HD/CD, from the datasheet's Available to Order section. The -E*/-H* suffixes are the exhaust (front-to-back, red latch) parts and -I*/-C* the intake (back-to-front, blue latch) parts, per the HIG's latch-colour convention."},"power":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"datasheet 'Typical power: 120 Watts (no transceiver)' - the vendor's own scope, hence power-envelope: bare; HIG Connecting Power, both DC and AC sections: 'The maximum system power consumption is 396.5 watts'. Fan bays at y 0.8 (42.2 in 43.8), PSUs at y 1.8 (40.2). Vendor art prints 'FAN \u25c0n' on each module face, not on the chassis - the fan component carries no numeral, so the numbering lives only in rel-pos; a chassis mark would be painted under the module."},"rows":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"photo-measured (SFP aperture centres y 14.97 and 30.44 - a 15.5 mm row pitch, against the TE reference 15.0 belly-to-belly, which is not governed by any spec; QSFP centres 15.1 and 30.56)"},"sfp-pitch":{"confidence":"registry","note":"registry (SFF-8433 14.25 mm; photo-measured 14.23-14.24 over 11 columns in each block, so the standard figure is used.
